queries_run: Brinker International tariff 2026 Chili's food costs

findings.claim: EAT 10-K FY2026 風險因子：美國或全球貿易政策變動（如新增或加徵食品／進口品關稅）可能持續推高成本、擾亂供應，並限制以定價保護利潤率的能力。
findings.excerpt: Changes in U.S. or global trade policy, such as new or increased tariffs on certain food products or other imported goods could continue to elevate costs, disrupt supply availability, and constrain our ability to protect operating margins through pricing strategies or adjustments in purchasing practices.

findings.claim: EAT 10-K FY2026 MD&A：地緣緊張與總體壓力導致產品成本通膨（含關稅）與供應鏈中斷。
findings.excerpt: Geopolitical tensions and broader macroeconomic pressures have led, and in the future may lead, to wage inflation, staffing challenges, product cost inflation (inclusive of tariffs), and/or supply chain disruptions.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：Q2 FY2026 財報電話會議稱，因家禽與乳製品價格下降及巴西牛肉關稅減免，全年商品通膨維持低個位數，下半年預期中個位數。
findings.source: AOL, Brinker EAT Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript（搜尋摘要）

reg_tariff_export.note: 未找到出口管制／實體清單相關來源（未搜尋，配額內優先關稅）；餐廳業態出口管制多半不適用。AOL 日期為推估。

clues.claim: Q2 FY2026 電話會議：巴西牛肉關稅減免、商品通膨低個位數。
